subject: Executive approval: enterprise support suite + custom integration concession
messages:
From: Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal questions — premium included + custom connector

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the console insights. We reviewed the commercial proposal and have two asks before we can get to legal:

1) Can you include the Premium Support package (24/7 SLA, named CSM, quarterly business reviews) as part of the first-year bundle?
2) We need a custom FHIR connector to map patient records into our pipeline. The scope is roughly 6 weeks of integration work (engineering + 1st-party connector).

Both items are deal-breakers for our procurement committee. Our target ARR is $950k with a start date of 2027-08-01. If you can accommodate, procurement will fast-track.

Attached: support_scope_v2.pdf (high-level connector scope)

Best,
Anna Lewis
Head of Platform
Crestline Health
[Attachment: support_scope_v2.pdf (pdf, 78KB)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lewis <anna.lewis@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal questions — premium included + custom connector

Anna — thanks for the clear note and the scope doc. I looped in our deal desk and PS leads to evaluate cost and impact. High level: premium support included is feasible as a time-limited concession; the FHIR connector request will require a small engineering scope and an SOW.

Next steps:
- I will escalate for executive approval on premium being included for year one.
- Our PS team will produce a SOW with estimated hours and a recommended fixed fee (aiming to avoid open time & materials).

I’ll get back to you by end of day tomorrow with the updated commercial.

Warmly,
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: EXEC: RDW-8421 — request approval for premium + fixed-fee connector

Team — quick context and ask. Crestline Health (target ARR $950k, start 2027-08-01) is pushing to have Premium Support bundled in year one and a fixed-fee custom FHIR connector (roughly 6 weeks). Procurement has signoff authority once both items are addressed.

Summary:
- Customer: Crestline Health (large provider, US)
- Commercial: $950k ARR, standard term 12 months, billed monthly
- Ask 1: Include Premium Support (24/7 SLA + named CSM + QBRs) for year one at no additional fee 
- Ask 2: SOW for FHIR connector: estimated 6 weeks engineering + QA; propose fixed fee instead of T&M to satisfy procurement

Impacts:
- Premium support unit economics: ~$60k run-rate in year one (reduced margin vs standard)
- Connector work: estimated 480 engineer hours (including QA & delivery), PS capacity stretch in July

Requested approval:
- Exec signoff to include Premium Support for first year as a one-time concession; and
- Allow PS to price connector as a fixed-fee SOW and accept a 15% uplift discount to close the deal quickly (the uplift offsets resource risk).

Attachments: SOW-draft_vRDW-8421.docx (PS will finalize)

Naomi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EXEC: RDW-8421 — request approval for premium + fixed-fee connector

Naomi — I reviewed the numbers. I can approve the Premium Support inclusion for year one subject to:
- Customer signs the attached SOW and pays 50% of the connector fee upfront; and
- We include a hard cap on PS effort with change-order rates above the cap.

I am hesitant to grant a 15% uplift discount on the SOW without Exec signoff; that materially reduces PS margin and sets a precedent. If Ben can OK a one-time 10% concession on the SOW (with the upfront payment and cap), I will greenlight.

Marissa
VP, Professional Services
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-draft_vRDW-8421.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EXEC: RDW-8421 — request approval for premium + fixed-fee connector (APPROVED)

Approved with conditions — Ben Carter (Head of Sales)

Approval summary:
1) Premium Support: APPROVED to include for year one at no charge.
2) Connector SOW: APPROVED as fixed-fee with the following constraints:
   - Maximum concession on SOW pricing: 10% discount only.
   - Customer must sign SOW and remit 50% deposit prior to work start.
   - PS to include a capped effort (480 hours) and an explicit change-order rate for any scope beyond the cap.

Reasoning: Close timing is strategic (large logo, long-term expansion potential). The 10% cap balances margin protection and competitive concession. If PS needs more runway in July, connect with finance for temporary capacity cover.

Naomi — proceed to update the commercial, attach revised SOW, and secure signoff from Anna (procurement). Rishi — mark deal in CRM as "exec-approved concession" and ensure deal desk records the exception.

Ben
Head of Sales
Redwood Inference
